statement: For the bounded weighted-group-LASSO bilevel loss class defined in the source, Pdim(L)=O(p^3*d+p^2*d^2).
quantifiers: For every well-defined class in the theorem; group weights and instance domain must make the lower problem attain a minimizer.
proof_route: Use nonnegative norm-lift variables, two FOL blocks of dimensions d and d+2p, then specialize C1 and simplify.
